_meta.what: Joint identification of the 11 2026 F1 cars over 9 circuits' qualifying laps: per-car tyre friction, aero, ICE power and mass; per-circuit wing level (downforce and drag trim) and grip.
_meta.label: estimates from public timing telemetry (OpenF1) · joint 9-circuit point-mass identification · effective parameters, not team data
_meta.data: OpenF1 (openf1.org) qualifying laps, concept/data/telemetry/ (an independent community feed, not associated with Formula 1, the FIA or FOM)

scale.kind: effective parameters of the point-mass model in concept/identify/model.js, not physical measurements
notes: mu_y, mu_x: effective friction at the reference load (μ(N) = μ·(1 − ls·(N/mg − 1))). Lateral g is measured as v_min²·max|κ| on x/y smoothed over max(6 m, 0.3 s·v); that estimator reads higher than an x/y-acceleration estimate (docs/concept/TRACK.md), so mu_y sits above tyre-test values. Compare cars with each other, not with a tyre table.
ClA_m2 trades against load_sensitivity and mu_y (the a_y(v) curve is what the corners measure). ay_100kmh_g / ay_200kmh_g / ay_250kmh_g and muy_ClA_over_m are the identifiable combinations.

CdA_m2 is conditional on the deployment anchor (top-3 straights reach the 350 kW MGU-K cap, C5.2.7) and on P_ice_kw. ICE power and drag are not separable from speed traces (P__ln_CdA correlation); P_ice_kw is prior-dominated. A circuit where the cap is not reached on the best exits (energy-limited) or where the anchor straights climb shows up as a higher drag trim there.
mass_kg is prior-dominated (726 kg + Nominal Tyre Mass + reported excess).
Reference conditions for car-level grip numbers: γ = 1 (mean of the 9 circuits), mean trim, ρ = 1.18 kg/m³.
scale.concept_sim_compatibility: Same tyre form as concept/sim/lapsim.js (μ0(1 + ls − ls·Fz/Fz0) per tyre equals this model per car when aero balance equals weight distribution; concept/sim adds lateral load transfer). Same units (m², kW, kg). NOT the same scale for ClA and μ: concept/sim measures curvature on its own averaged racing line and fits on one lap, so values do not transfer one to one; see sim_compat for the Silverstone check of these cars inside concept/sim.

eta_k.source: assumption (MGU-K DC to shaft), as concept/tools/derive-car.js

alpha_slip_rad.source: assumption (slip angle at the lateral limit, cornering drag), as derive-car

mass.note: per car: 726 kg (C4.1) + Nominal Tyre Mass central + the team's reported excess (grid-2026.json); sd 5 kg (NTM band and reporting)

ls.source: priors-2026.json load_sensitivity (3-6 %/kN × static tyre load 1.90 kN)

gamma.source: judgement: circuit grip factor within ±15 % of the 9-circuit mean (surface, temperature, and the circuit's curvature-estimate bias)

w.source: judgement: a circuit's downforce trim within ±30 % (log) of the car's mean

d.source: judgement: a circuit's drag trim within ±30 % (log) of the car's mean

pu_tie_kw.source: judgement: teams on the same power unit within ~8 kW of their family mean

method.summary: Robust (Huber) maximum a posteriori fit of corner lateral g, brake-zone speed traces and a per-lap MGU-K deployment anchor over every usable qualifying lap of 9 circuits, all cars at once; uncertainty from a bootstrap over laps (within each car-circuit cell) and over corners / brake zones / straights within laps, with prior centres and assumptions re-drawn in each replicate; validation by leave-one-circuit-out and a QSS lap simulation on each lap's own path.

observations.corners: grip-limited corner minima: a_y = v_min²·max|κ| within ±40 m
observations.brakes: speed-vs-distance through each brake zone (onset + 0.25 s to 70 % of the drop)
observations.anchor: mean of the top-3 per-straight 25 m windows (180-290 km/h) of implied MGU-K DC power = 350 kW

exclusion_policy: C1, C2, C5, C6 FAIL: lap excluded
C3 FAIL raw brake 104: brake channel excluded (no brake zones)
C3 FAIL null run > 200 m: the stretch ±100 m excluded from every feature; lap left out of the lap-time check
C3 FAIL other channel range: lap excluded
C4 FAIL > 10 longitudinal accel violations: longitudinal channel excluded (no anchor, no brake zones)
C4 FAIL >= 5 speed jumps: lap excluded
every lap: frozen speed feed (same speed, throttle, rpm for >= 1 s above 50 km/h) masked
